# Open Loops

Use this page for unresolved questions, missing evidence, contradictions, stale claims, and follow-up work that should not disappear into chat history.

## Loop table

| Status | Domain | Question or loop | Next action | Related |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Open | health | Which health and energy experiments should become recurring personal practice? | Capture typed raw experiment notes before changing evergreen pages. | [Health, Energy & Readiness](/wiki/health-energy-and-readiness) |
| Open | venture | Which recurring venture patterns are actual demand versus creator hype? | Separate mechanics from revenue claims and verify outside the source. | [Venture Opportunity Discovery](/wiki/venture-opportunity-discovery), [Claim Review](/wiki/claim-review) |
| Open | canada-policy | Which Canada policy claims are durable ideas versus current political claims? | Route external-use claims to claim review before publication. | [Canadian Prosperity Agenda](/wiki/canadian-prosperity-agenda), [Claim Review](/wiki/claim-review) |
| Open | ai-software | Which AI-agent practices are durable systems principles versus fast-aging product features? | Mark product feature claims as time-sensitive. | [AI, Agents & Software Systems](/wiki/ai-agents-and-software-systems), [Agent Execution Systems](/wiki/agent-execution-systems) |
| Open | self-meaning | Which personal philosophy and attention notes should be treated as private synthesis rather than source-backed claims? | Capture personal reflections as typed raw sources. | [Self, Meaning & Attention](/wiki/self-meaning-and-attention), [Source Intake Guide](/wiki/source-intake-guide) |

## File-back rules

- Add a loop here when a query produces an unresolved but durable question.
- Link to the relevant domain page.
- Move claims needing verification to [Claim Review](/wiki/claim-review).
- Move good source trails to [Research Leads](/wiki/research-leads).
- Move chosen actions or commitments to [Decision Log](/wiki/decision-log).
